title: ben_franklin_effect
hook_strength_notes: Opens with a reversal of common wisdom, creates immediate curiosity gap

beats.text: Doing favors makes people like you less, not more.
It's called the Ben Franklin effect.
Franklin got a rival to like him by asking to borrow a book.
Not by doing the rival a favor. By asking for one.
Your brain justifies effort by deciding it must like the person.
So next time you want someone to like you,
stop helping them. Ask them to help you.

cta: Try it once this week — and watch what happens.
